definitions.gloss: true story; real account; factual story
definitions.explanation: A story or account based on events that actually happened, as opposed to fiction. Often used in titles of books, movies, and TV shows.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実話|じつわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: This movie is based on a true story.

examples.japanese: {実話|じつわ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised to hear it was a true story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もとにした{実話|じつわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦ベストセラー→ベストセラー：11289_besutoseraa⟧になった。
examples.english: A true story based on her experiences was published as a book and became a bestseller.

notes:
USAGE: {実話|じつわ} emphasizes that a story is factual rather than fictional. Very commonly used in entertainment media: {実話|じつわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧ (based on a true story).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実話|じつわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on a true story
- {実話|じつわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{映画化|えいがか}→映画化：23773_eigaka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn a true story into a movie
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実話|じつわ}: a moving true story
- ⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実話|じつわ}: a shocking true story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実話|じつわ}: true story (emphasis on factual accuracy)
- ⟦{逸話|いつわ}→逸話：14322_itsuwa⟧: anecdote (interesting episode about a person)
- ⟦{作|つく}り{話|ばなし}→作り話：11557_tsukuribanashi⟧: made-up story, fiction
